persona.who: Someone in Outlook and Excel: Priya, the HR coordinator from the earlier runs. Starter on a computer, not sure what her company allows.
persona.bio: Priya, 33, HR coordinator at a logistics company with about 300 people. She works in Outlook and Excel all day, beside the company's HR system: scheduling interviews, sending offer letters and onboarding emails, answering the same policy questions about leave and benefits, keeping the onboarding checklist in Excel, keeping employee records up to date, and writing the monthly HR newsletter. Onboarding and the same benefits questions take the most time. She tried Copilot a few times. She is not sure what the company allows with employee data.
